description: OHLCV candles for indicator/momentum strategies (RSI, moving averages, breakouts) — resolve_symbol first to get the coinId. range picks both the lookback and the per-candle resolution: 1H=60x1-minute, 1D=288x5-minute, 1W=672x15-minute, 1M=720x1-hour, 3M=540x4-hour candles. Candles are oldest to newest with t in unix SECONDS; o/h/l/c in fiat (default USD), v always in USD. These are sampled composite-price bars, not venue trade candles. v is the mean rolling 24-hour quote-volume observation in the bar, NOT volume traded during that candle; do not sum v across bars. Paper trading only — virtual funds (50,000 mUSD). Not financial advice. Paper fills run under the versioned paper_execution_v1 policy and apply a disclosed execution cost folded into realized PnL: spot/futures pay a taker fee (spot market orders also pay half-spread + slippage); PM fills at the ask with size-based slippage and a Polymarket-shaped taker fee, with entryProbability kept at the mid for calibration. See the executionModel in quote/trade results — a rehearsal cost, not an exchange fill guarantee.
